肖恩跟车，随米娅一起离开。

白塔也派来了另外一队人类后勤兵，收拾两车相撞之后的烂摊子。

秦夙再转身，路边树下，就只剩魏知弦和蕾拉两个人。

她拿着仪器径直走向魏知弦。

“我的精神污染程度是63%。”魏知弦后退了一小步，“没必要再测了。”

秦夙直接上去，举高仪器，对着他脖子就按下了按钮！

“滴。”

“精神污染程度：63%。”

虽然验证了魏知弦说的是实话，秦夙还是在听到仪器播报后瞪了他一眼。

见他脖子的小针孔溢出一滴血。

秦夙把指尖靠近，探出点红色的精神力覆盖上去，这小小的伤口顷刻间就被治愈了。

“海莉换队后，我不想请不熟悉的向导帮忙，本来是打算等你康复，找机会向你求助的。”魏知弦弯腰想去抓秦夙的手，帮他把指尖上的血迹擦掉。

秦夙却很顺手的把仪器和探针盒子都塞给了他，“走吧，去疏导中心，我现在就好好帮帮你。”

这个阴阳怪气的劲，魏知弦当然看得出来。

蕾拉也看出来了。

她垂着眼，两手手指绞在一起，嘴唇翕动了两下，“秦夙向导，请不要怪魏老师……”

“怎么哪儿都有你？”秦夙皱眉瞪她，“和你有什么关系？你怎么逮住谁都要跟我求个情？搞的我好像是个横行霸道不讲道理的混球似的！”

骂完，秦夙转头就朝白塔方向走去。

“你先回去休息吧。”

魏知弦匆忙跟蕾拉交代了一句，放出自己的精神体黑豹，就去追秦夙的脚步。

黑豹顺应主人的想法，绕在秦夙脚边，半人高的大家伙，嗓子里呼噜呼噜的，不时用湿润的舌头去舔秦夙的手指头尖尖。

之前没被魏知弦擦掉的血迹，都让豹子舔掉了。

而精神体的主人，虽然亦步亦趋跟在秦夙身旁，却有点不知道怎么哄人了。

抿了半天的嘴，弯腰低头，“姐……”

“我可没有你这么有本事的弟弟。”秦夙腔调更充满了挖苦，“你说你们小队成员的关系如同一盘散沙，一点都不团结，要你从中调和凝聚，都是骗我的吧？”

“我没说过一盘散沙，没到那种程度。”魏知弦严谨的纠正完，再软下嗓子，“姐，我跟你说的话都是真的，没有骗过你任何事。”

“不骗，只瞒着是吧？”秦夙冷笑了下，“离颂跟萧岑到底是怎么回事？谢尘无三缄其口，你也只字不提？”

魏知弦顿了顿，叹口气，“你是你，她是她。何况他们兄妹之间的事，我未知全貌，怎么能随意评价，更不可能断章取义的向你转达，再说，你也没有问过我。”

Sean followed the car and left with Mia.

White Tower also sent another team of human logistics soldiers to clean up the mess after the collision between the two cars.

Qin Su turned around again, and there were only two people left under the tree on the roadside, Wei Zhixian and Leila.

She walked straight to Wei Zhixian with the instrument in hand.

"My mental pollution level is 63%." Wei Zhixian took a small step back, "There is no need to test again."

Qin Su went up directly, raised the instrument, and pressed the button towards his neck!

"Drip."

"Level of mental pollution: 63%."

Although it was verified that Wei Zhixian was telling the truth, Qin Su still glared at him after hearing the instrument's broadcast.

A drop of blood spilled from the small pinhole on his neck.

Qin Su brought his fingertips close and stretched out a little red spiritual power to cover it. The small wound was healed instantly.

"After Haili changed teams, I didn't want to ask an unfamiliar guide for help. I originally planned to wait for you to recover and find an opportunity to ask you for help." Wei Zhixian bent down to grab Qin Su's hand and help him wipe away the blood on his fingertips.

Qin Su handed him the instrument and probe box smoothly, "Let's go to the guidance center. I will help you now."

Of course Wei Zhixian could see this yin and yang energy.

Layla saw it too.

She lowered her eyes, twisted her fingers together, and moved her lips twice, "Guide Qin Su, please don't blame Teacher Wei..."

"Why are you everywhere?" Qin Su frowned and glared at her, "What does it have to do with you? Why do you want to beg for mercy from anyone you catch? It makes me seem like a domineering and unreasonable bastard!"

After scolding, Qin Su turned around and walked towards the White Tower.

"You go back and rest first."

Wei Zhixian hurriedly confessed to Leila, released his spiritual body Black Panther, and followed Qin Su's footsteps.

The black panther complied with his master's idea and circled around Qin Su's feet. The big guy, half a man tall, purred in his throat and licked the tips of Qin Su's fingers with his wet tongue from time to time.

The blood stains that had not been wiped away by Wei Zhixian were all licked away by the leopard.

As for the master of the spiritual body, although he followed Qin Su step by step, he didn't know how to coax him.

After pouting for a long time, he bent down and said, "Sister..."

"I don't have a brother as capable as you." Qin Su's tone was even more sarcastic, "You said that the relationship between the members of your team is like a loose sand, with no unity at all, and you want you to reconcile and cohere. Are you lying to me?"

"I never said it was a mess, not to that extent." Wei Zhixian corrected him rigorously, then softened his voice and said, "Sister, everything I told you is true, and I have never lied to you about anything."

"You're not lying, you're just hiding it, right?" Qin Su sneered, "What's going on with Li Song and Xiao Cen? Xie Chenwu kept silent, and you didn't say a word about it either?"

Wei Zhixian paused and sighed, "You are you, she is she. Besides, I don't know the whole story about their brother and sister. How can I comment at will, let alone convey it to you out of context? Besides, you didn't ask me."
